proposals.gini: median singular-value Gini; zero is flat
proposals.decay_slope: median OLS slope of log(s_i) against i=1..16
proposals.hill_tail_contrast: median mean_{i<=8} log(lambda_i/lambda_9), lambda=s^2; 1/(alpha_hill-1), zero at flat endpoint
proposals.erank_iqr: IQR of module shannon effective ranks
proposals.erank_depth_slope: OLS slope of layer-median erank against raw layer index
proposals.erank_attn_mlp_gap: median attention erank minus median MLP erank
proposals.gamma_param: global sum(w*beta), w=source_s^2/sum(source_s^2); equals previous scalar_fit
proposals.eta_param: 1-gamma^2/sum(w*beta^2); equals previous shape_residual in common U/V
proposals.original_head1_retention: previous actual original leading-direction energy retention
proposals.previous_mean_entropy_rank: previous mean module effective rank/16; aggregation comparator

incomplete_diagnostics.alpha_weighted_hill: median alpha_hill*log10(sigma1_scaled^2); Hill-based diagnostic, not official WeightWatcher PL fit
incomplete_diagnostics.alpha_iqr: IQR of module alpha_hill, defined only if every module is nondegenerate
incomplete_diagnostics.kurtosis: median population excess kurtosis of 16 singular values; flat spectrum undefined

functional.functional_attn_mlp_gap: attention median functional erank minus MLP median

selection: Proposed user metrics evaluated without accepting supplied correlations as evidence; no performance-selected aggregation.
aggregation: module medians; IQR separately; attention-MLP gap explicit. Raw parameter and energy weights include original LoRA scaling.
precision: singular shape normalized by module maximum; relative spread below 1e-5 treated as flat. Shape features rounded to 1e-5. Hill mean log contrast <=1e-4 is undefined, never capped.
validation: same grouped statistics / nested seed-base-task CV as prior study, separate cohorts, edited-only sensitivity. Incomplete alpha/kurtosis/family excluded from complete-case CV.
functional_scope: six seed42 source checkpoints; frozen-base training-distribution cache 256 samples, max512 tokens. No fabricated seeds43/44 activations.
independent_unit: 18 source checkpoints (6 functional); repeated waves not independent replications

base_subspace_plan.algorithm: CPU randomized SVD q96 power12, adaptive q128/power24 or q192/power36; k16 residual <0.01 and k32 residual <0.02
base_subspace_plan.aggregation: global adapter parameter-energy fractions; no base-forward inference

source_cv_plan: 18 untouched sources, nested leave-seed-out; inner leave-source-out selects one linear spectral covariate and ridge; training-only Base×Task group means as explicit baseline; target + absolute forgetting equal normalized objective
metric_selection_note: exploratory user-proposed shortlist; raw source correlations inspected before source-CV implementation; held-out seed results never used to select fold features
